problems: 'more than' can read as 'rather than' or 'in addition to'
reviews.rewrite: AI is better understood as a new kind of mind than as a tool or artifact.

problems: 'real' sets no threshold, so a tiny risk counts and agreeing is easy
'real' implies disagreeing means calling it imaginary
reviews.rewrite: Advanced AI poses a non-negligible risk of human extinction.

problems: 'collective choice' is warm while 'inevitable process' reads as fatalism
false binary: no room for mixed causes
reviews.rewrite: Collective choices, not a process that runs its own course, decide how technology reshapes work and society.

problems: 'without any change' makes agreeing sound extreme
no timeframe for 'better off'
reviews.rewrite: Technology-driven productivity growth leaves most workers better off even if public policy stays as it is.

problems: near-truism: disagreeing feels disreputable
unclear whether 'compatible' means in principle or in practice today
cannot be clarified without picking one meaning
'hype' is already pejorative and 'inflated hype' doubles it
'public promises' does not say whose promises
reviews.rewrite: Most public claims about what advanced AI will do overstate what it will actually deliver.

problems: 'humane' is an applause word: disagreeing sounds anti-humane
'liberal and humane' joins two sets of ideals
'inherent force' is vague
reviews.rewrite: Liberal, humane ideals are strong enough on their own merits to prevail in long contests between societies.

problems: 'limits' has no degree: any limiting effect makes it true, so agreeing is easy
fixing the degree would change the meaning
'stage to surpass' frames the opposing view as treating humans as disposable
'the end that AI serves' is philosophical jargon
agreeing reads as simply pro-human
reviews.rewrite: AI should exist to serve human beings, rather than to bring about beings meant to succeed humanity.

problems: 'inflated by hype' is loaded and redundant
presupposes hype is present
near-duplicate of ai-promises-inflated
reviews.rewrite: Public discussion of AI generally claims more than the technology has so far shown it can do.

problems: 'present' vs unstated future makes the second option sound speculative
either/or excludes 'both equally'
reviews.rewrite: The AI dangers that most deserve attention come from how people deploy AI now, not from autonomous superintelligent agents.

problems: 'may come to' is a very low bar, so agreeing costs little
'rights' is a far stronger claim than 'moral consideration'
needs splitting, which changes the item
'behave and be received' joins how AI develops with how society reacts
'valid guide' has no degree
reviews.rewrite: Earlier general-purpose technologies are a reliable guide to how AI will develop and how society will respond to it.

problems: 'deferring' sounds passive vs the more dignified 'one's own reasoning'
'base rates' and 'average of informed opinion' are different things
reviews.rewrite: On hard questions, base rates or the average of informed opinion are usually a better default than one's own reasoning.

problems: 'rule by' and 'unelected powers' are pejorative
'executives' could mean CEOs or elected heads of government
agreeing feels like simply backing democracy
reviews.rewrite: Political authority should continue to rest on popular self-government rather than on experts, corporate executives or other unelected bodies.

problems: 'binding rules' is unspecified, so mild and strict regulators both agree
joins a verdict (more harm than good) with a cause (deterring innovation)
'stringent' leans negative
reviews.rewrite: Strict AI regulation now would do more harm than good, because it would deter innovation.

problems: 'remain' presupposes AI is now separate from the state
unclear if it covers funding, procurement or only control
reviews.rewrite: AI development should not be directed or controlled by the state.

problems: 'cooperation across diverse groups' is warm while 'convergence on a singularity' sounds cold and sci-fi
'singularity' is jargon with several meanings
reviews.rewrite: Technology should aim to help diverse groups cooperate rather than to reach a technological singularity.

problems: presupposes the US has a lead
'press ahead' and 'protect its lead' are two policies
presupposition cannot be removed without changing meaning
reviews.rewrite: Rivalry with China is a good reason for the United States to push ahead in advanced technology and keep its lead.

problems: 'wealth or ownership' joins cash payments with equity stakes
'a sound way' (one of many) is a low bar
'slowed or stopped' lets 'slow only' and 'stop' voters both agree
splitting would change the item
'can and should' joins feasibility with desirability; almost no one rejects 'should'
'good outcomes' is an applause phrase
needs splitting into 'can', which changes the item
